text: How to know if the girl likes you Hi, I saw you respond to others on IG, so I thought I'd just pop in and send a message. I really like this girl, but I'm unsure whether she likes me back. We have known each other, probably we have been knowing each other for some months personally, and I feel like I'm getting mixed signals. Or maybe I'm just out of it right now, and I'm blinded by my crush. Any tips on how to spot any signs, give her subtle hints, or find out whether she likes me? Okay guys, let me remind you of one of the main rules you should follow if you want to have a great life as a man, especially when it comes to dating. Simplify, don't complicate. Here we have another example of a guy who, instead of acting, decided to first talk and be friends with a girl, thinking that it would help him get her. And now he's trying to look for signs whether she likes him back. Simplify, don't complicate. The simplest thing you can do to check if she likes you is to directly and unequivocally ask her on a date. You say, hey, whatever her name is, I wanna go out with you, let's have some drinks. And if she asks, like friends, or are you asking me out on a date? You say, I am asking you on a date. That's it, simple as that. And there you go. She either says yes, which means she most probably has emotions towards you, so do act on the date and try to move through stages. Or she says no. Then you say, okay, no problem. You stop talking to her and instead spend that energy and time working on yourself and asking out other girls. I know it can be scary. And you probably have a million doubts in your head. What if she says no? What if it makes things awkward? What if I still see her around? What, what, what? But this is the risk you should start taking in your life. And by being more adventurous, your life will become so much better. If you get rejected, who cares? It doesn't make you less of a man if you asked out a girl that you like and got rejected. If anything, it makes you more of a man. And the only person who doesn't get rejected is the one who never tries anything. Simplify, don't complicate. Guys, stop befriending the girls you like. If you like the girl, go for it, ask her out. The response from her will be your sign, cue, and answer. Respect yourself and your time. And believe me, if you start following this rule, in the long term, you will be so much happier.
